15-mashqda bastakorlarni QAYSI TARTIBDA eshitish faqat audiodan bilinadi — tartib to'qib yozilmadi. Kim nimani bastalagani esa kitobda yozilgan va to'liq berildi.

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo): 14-mashqda rassom nomi 'PIÈRRE-Auguste Renoir' deb yozilgan — 'e' ustida urg'u belgisi bilan. To'g'ri yozilishi — PIERRE-Auguste Renoir, urg'usiz. Xuddi shu xato 72-betdagi 'Pièrre Curie' da ham bor. Kitob matni asl holida qoldirildi.

⚠⚠ CHALG'ITUVCHI NOM: 15-mashqda bastakor 'FRANÇOIS Chopin' deb berilgan. Uning to'liq fransuzcha ismi — Frederic Francois Chopin, lekin dunyoda u FREDERIC CHOPIN nomi bilan mashhur. 'Francois Chopin' deb qidirsangiz deyarli hech narsa topmaysiz. Kitob uning O'RTA ismini ishlatgan.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI (to'g'ri chiqqanlari): Fleming Shotlandiyada 1881-yil 6-avgustda tug'ilgan, penitsillinni 1928-yilda kashf etgan, 1945-yilda Nobel mukofotini olgan, 1955-yil 11-martda vafot etgan va Sankt-Pol soborida dafn qilingan — hammasi to'g'ri. Motsart 1756-yilda Zalsburgda tug'ilgan, 1781-yilda Konstansiya Veberga uylangan, 1791-yilda 35 yoshida vafot etgan — bu ham to'g'ri.
audioRequiredUz: 14-mashq — rasm va rassomlarni moslashni tinglab tekshirish. 15-mashq — to'rt musiqa parchasini tinglab bastakorlarni tartiblash.

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling rules for the past simple.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lga -ED qo'shamiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga faqat -D qo'shamiz.
        I love  →  I loved

  3) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I study  →  I studied

  4) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI shakli bor.
        become  →  became
        say     →  said
     Kitobning OXIRIDAGI noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — 3-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:

  UNDOSH + Y  →  Y tushadi, -IED
     stUDy   → studied   (d — undosh)
     marRY   → married   (r — undosh)
     carRY   → carried
     buRY    → buried
     tRY     → tried

  UNLI + Y   →  Y QOLADI, faqat -ED
     enjOY   → enjoyed   (o — unli)
     plAY    → played    (a — unli)
     stAY    → stayed

  12-mashqdagi 'BUT enjoy' shu farqni ko'rsatish uchun.

QO'ShIMCHA QOIDA (kitobda yo'q, lekin foydali):
  Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH bo'lgan fe'lda
  oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  travel → travelled

points.en: We add -ed to most regular verbs. I work - I worked
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Eng oddiy holat: watch → watched, call → called.

points.en: We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I love - I loved
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
'-ed' emas, faqat '-d' — chunki 'e' allaqachon bor.
care → cared;  die → died;  complete → completed.

points.en: Verbs ending in consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I study - I studied
points.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'lda -y tushib, -ied qo'shiladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
FAQAT UNDOSH + Y uchun.
marry → married;  bury → buried;  carry → carried.

points.en: Other verbs have irregular forms: become - became, say - said.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 4-QOIDA.
Ularni YODLASH kerak — qoida yo'q.

points.en: Look at the list of irregular verbs at the back of the book.
points.uz: Kitobning oxiridagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.
points.noteUz: Enterprise kitobining oxirida to'liq ro'yxat bor.

points.en: BUT: vowel + y keeps the -y. enjoy - enjoyed
points.noteUz:
12-mashqdagi 'BUT enjoy' shuni ko'rsatadi.
play → played;  stay → stayed.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the past simple forms of the verbs below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASHQ UCH QUTIGA BO'LINGAN — HAR BIRI BOSHQA QOIDA:

  1-QUTI (chap): work, watch, call, appear, end, return
                 → oddiy + ED
     1-QUTI (o'ng): complete, love, care, divorce,
                    continue, die
                 → oxiri -E, faqat + D

  2-QUTI: study, marry  BUT  enjoy
                 → undosh+Y → IED,  LEKIN unli+Y → ED

  3-QUTI: write, buy, make, go
                 → NOTO'G'RI fe'llar (yodlash kerak)

Qutilarning o'zi qoidani ko'rsatib turibdi.

items.whyUz:
Oxiri undosh 'k' → oddiy holat → + ED.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.

Oxiri 'ch' → + ED.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.

Oxiri 'll' → + ED.
-ed /d/ deb o'qiladi.

Oxiri 'r' → + ED.
-ed /d/ deb o'qiladi.

Oxiri 'd' → + ED.
DIQQAT: -ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi — QO'ShIMCHA bo'g'in
('endid' kabi), chunki oxiri 'd'.

Oxiri 'n' → + ED.
-ed /d/ deb o'qiladi.

Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Oxiri 'e' → 'loveed' EMAS, 'loved'.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.

Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.

Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.
DIQQAT: -ing shaklida boshqacha — 'dying' (ie → y).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'd' — undosh, keyin 'y' → Y tushadi, -IED qo'shiladi.

'r' — undosh, keyin 'y' → -IED.
71-betdagi matnda bor.

'o' — UNLI tovush, keyin 'y' → Y QOLADI, faqat + ED.
'enjoied' XATO.
Kitobdagi 'BUT' aynan shu farqni ta'kidlash uchun.
Shunga o'xshash: play → played, stay → stayed.

write → WROTE — noto'g'ri fe'l.
'writed' XATO.
Uchinchi shakli: written.

buy → BOUGHT — noto'g'ri fe'l.
DIQQAT: 'y' bor, lekin 3-qoida ISHLAMAYDI —
bu noto'g'ri fe'l. 'buyed' XATO.
O'qilishi /bɔːt/.

make → MADE — noto'g'ri fe'l.
DIQQAT: oxiri 'e' bor, lekin 2-qoida ISHLAMAYDI —
'maked' XATO.

go → WENT — butunlay boshqa so'z.
'goed' XATO.
Uchinchi shakli: gone.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple. Which verbs are irregular?
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying. Qaysi fe'llar noto'g'ri?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sir Alexander Fleming WAS a famous scientist. He was born
  in Scotland on 6th August, 1881. He STUDIED medicine at
  St Mary's Hospital in London. After World War I, he
  RETURNED to St Mary's and WORKED there as a professor.

  In 1915, he MARRIED Sarah Marion McElroy and they HAD a
  son. He DISCOVERED penicillin in 1928 and RECEIVED the
  Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945. His wife DIED in 1949.
  Fleming married again in 1953. His second wife WAS a
  Greek doctor, Dr Amalia Koutsouris.

  Fleming DIED on 11th March, 1955. They BURIED him in
  St Paul's Cathedral.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ser Aleksandr Fleming mashhur olim edi. U 1881-yil
  6-avgustda Shotlandiyada tug'ilgan. U Londondagi Avliyo
  Meri kasalxonasida tibbiyot o'qidi. Birinchi jahon
  urushidan keyin Avliyo Meriga qaytdi va u yerda professor
  bo'lib ishladi.
  1915-yilda Sara Marion Makelroyga uylandi va ularning
  o'g'li bo'ldi. U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va
  1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
  Xotini 1949-yilda vafot etdi. Fleming 1953-yilda qayta
  uylandi. Ikkinchi xotini yunon shifokori — doktor Amaliya
  Kutsuris edi.
  Fleming 1955-yil 11-martda vafot etdi. Uni Avliyo Pavel
  soborida dafn etishdi.

SAVOLGA JAVOB — QAYSI FE'LLAR NOTO'G'RI?
  BE   → WAS  (1 va 10-bandlar)
  HAVE → HAD  (6-band)
  Qolgan hammasi TO'G'RI fe'l (-ed oladi).

DIQQAT — 'BURY' YOZILISHI:
  bury → BURIED  ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
  O'qilishi /ˈberi/ — 'beri' kabi ('byuri' EMAS).

DIQQAT — DIANA BILAN BOG'LIQLIK:
  Fleming ham 'St Paul's Cathedral' da —
  Diana ham o'sha soborda turmush qurgan (71-bet).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  medicine       = tibbiyot; dori
  a professor    = professor
  World War I    = Birinchi jahon urushi
  penicillin     = penitsillin (birinchi antibiotik)
  to bury        = dafn etmoq
  Greek          = yunon

items.textEn: 1  Sir Alexander Fleming ............ (be) a famous scientist.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'Sir Alexander Fleming' BIRLIK → was (were EMAS).
SAVOLGA JAVOB: bu — NOTO'G'RI fe'l.

items.textEn: 2  He ............ (study) medicine at St Mary's Hospital in London.
items.whyUz:
study → studied (Y → I + ED).
TO'G'RI fe'l.
'medicine' = tibbiyot;  'study AT' — predlog AT.

items.textEn: 3  After World War I, he ............ (return) to St Mary's ...
items.whyUz:
return → returned. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'return TO' — predlog TO.
'World War I' = 'World War One' deb o'qiladi.

work → worked. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'work AS a professor' = professor bo'lib ishlamoq.

marry → married (Y → I + ED). TO'G'RI fe'l.
DIQQAT: 'married WITH' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

have → HAD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'haved' XATO.
SAVOLGA JAVOB: bu ham — NOTO'G'RI fe'l.

discover → discovered. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'penicillin' = penitsillin — birinchi antibiotik,
millionlab odam hayotini saqlab qolgan.

items.textEn: 8  ... and ............ (receive) the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945.
items.whyUz:
receive → received (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D). TO'G'RI fe'l.
'the Nobel Prize FOR Medicine' — predlog FOR.
Yozilishi: 'i' dan OLDIN 'e' ('recieve' XATO).

die → died. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'his wife' BIRLIK.

items.textEn: 10  His second wife ............ (be) a Greek doctor.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS. NOTO'G'RI fe'l (1-band bilan bir xil).
'his second wife' BIRLIK → was.
'Greek' = yunon.

die → died. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'ON 11th March, 1955' — aniq sana → ON.

items.textEn: 12  They ............ (bury) him in St Paul's Cathedral.
items.whyUz:
bury → BURIED ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED). TO'G'RI fe'l.
O'qilishi /ˈberid/ — 'berid' kabi.
'to bury' = dafn etmoq.
DIQQAT: 'They buried him' — 'they' bu yerda
aniq odamlar emas, umumiy ma'noda.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the paintings to the painters, then listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni rassomlarga moslang, so'ng tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT RASSOM:
  a. Pièrre-Auguste Renoir  — fransuz impressionisti
  b. Leonardo da Vinci      — italyan Uyg'onish davri ustasi
  c. Edgar Degas            — fransuz impressionisti
  d. Frans Hals             — golland rassomi

TO'RT ASAR:
  1  Mona Lisa            (jilmayayotgan ayol portreti)
  2  Child with Cat       (mushukli qiz bola)
  3  The Laughing Cavalier (kulayotgan mo'ylovli zodagon)
  4  Two Dancers          (ikki balerina)

USUL — MAVZUGA QARAB TOPING:
  Degas — BALERINALARNI chizishi bilan mashhur
  Renoir — bolalar va oilaviy sahnalar
  Hals — kulayotgan portretlar (Gollandiya, XVII asr)
  Leonardo — Mona Liza dunyodagi eng mashhur rasm

Leonardo da Vinci 70-betdagi 1-mashqda ham bor edi
('Italian artist, 1452 - 1519').

pairs.whyUz:
Dunyodagi eng mashhur rasm, Parijdagi Luvrda saqlanadi.
Leonardo — 70-betdagi F-rasm ('Italian artist, 1452-1519').

Renuar bolalar va oilaviy sahnalarni yumshoq, iliq
ranglarda chizgan — impressionizm.
Rasmda mushuk quchoqlagan qiz bola.

Frans Hals — golland rassomi (XVII asr),
kulayotgan va jonli portretlari bilan mashhur.
'a cavalier' = otliq zodagon.

Dega BALET va balerinalarni chizishi bilan mashhur.
Uning yuzlab balet rasmlari bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Now say who painted each painting.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi har bir rasmni kim chizganini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  [rassom] PAINTED [asar nomi].
  yoki
  [asar nomi] WAS PAINTED BY [rassom].

DIQQAT — 'PAINT' TO'G'RI FE'L:
  paint → PAINTED (oddiy + ED).

DIQQAT — ASAR NOMLARI:
  Rasm nomlari KURSIV yoki qo'shtirnoqda yoziladi.
  'the Mona Lisa' — mashhur asarlar oldidan ko'pincha 'the'.

items.answer: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
items.whyUz:
paint → painted (to'g'ri fe'l).
Majhul shakli: 'The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.'

items.answer: Pièrre-Auguste Renoir painted Child with Cat.
items.whyUz: Renuar — bolalar mavzusidagi rassom.

items.answer: Frans Hals painted The Laughing Cavalier.
items.whyUz: Hals — kulayotgan portretlar ustasi.
Dega — balerinalarni chizgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to these pieces of music. Number the composers in the order you hear their pieces of music.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu musiqa parchalarini tinglang. Bastakorlarni musiqalarini eshitgan tartibingizda raqamlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT BASTAKOR VA ULARNING ASARLARI
(kitobda YOZILGAN — bu qism to'liq bilinadi):

  Wolfgang Amadeus MOZART  composed  REQUIEM
  Johann STRAUSS           composed  THE BLUE DANUBE
  Antonio VIVALDI          composed  THE FOUR SEASONS
  François CHOPIN          composed  the POLONAISE-FANTAISIE

DIQQAT — TARTIB AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:
  Mashq musiqalarni ESHITGAN TARTIBDA raqamlashni so'raydi.
  Bu tartib kitobda YOZILMAGAN — faqat audioda bor.
  Shuning uchun bu yerda TO'QIB yozilmadi.
  Audioni tinglaganingizda o'zingiz 1, 2, 3, 4 deb
  raqamlaysiz.

BASTAKORLAR HAQIDA:
  MOZART (1756-1791)  — avstriyalik, 16-mashqda tarjimai
                        holi yoziladi. 'Requiem' — uning
                        so'nggi, tugallanmagan asari.
  STRAUSS (1825-1899) — avstriyalik, 'vals qiroli'.
                        72-betdagi 7-mashqda ham bor edi.
                        'The Blue Danube' = 'Ko'k Dunay' valsi.
  VIVALDI (1678-1741) — italyan. 'The Four Seasons' =
                        'To'rt fasl' — to'rtta skripka konserti.
  CHOPIN (1810-1849)  — polshalik-fransuz pianinochi.
                        'Polonez' — polyak raqsi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to compose    = bastalamoq
  a composer    = bastakor
  a piece of music = musiqa parchasi
  in order      = tartib bilan

points.noteUz:
Motsart — avstriyalik bastakor (1756-1791).
'Requiem' — uning so'nggi asari, tugallanmagan.
16-mashqda uning tarjimai holi yoziladi.

points.en: Johann Strauss composed The Blue Danube.
points.noteUz:
Shtraus — 'vals qiroli' (1825-1899).
72-betdagi 7-mashqda sanalari berilgan edi.
'the Danube' = Dunay daryosi (daryo nomi → THE).

points.en: Antonio Vivaldi composed The Four Seasons.
points.noteUz:
Vivaldi — italyan bastakori (1678-1741).
'The Four Seasons' — to'rtta skripka konserti:
bahor, yoz, kuz, qish.

Shopen — polshalik-fransuz bastakori (1810-1849).
Asosan pianino uchun yozgan.
'a polonaise' = polyak xalq raqsi.

compose + -ER → composer.
TO'G'RI fe'l: compose → composed (oxiri 'e' → + D).

exercises.instructionEn: First, put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI USTUN — A va B.
Har birida qavsda fe'l bor, uni o'tgan zamonga qo'yasiz.

A USTUNI (6 ta gap boshi)
B USTUNI (6 ta gap davomi)

Hamma fe'l TO'G'RI (-ed), faqat uchtasi NOTO'G'RI:
  be    → was
  have  → had
  learn → learnt (yoki learned)

items.whyUz: love → loved (2-qoida).

start → started.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
'start WRITING' — 'start' dan keyin -ing shakli.

items.textEn: A3  He ............ (tour) around western Europe with his father
items.whyUz:
tour → toured.
'to tour' = gastrol qilmoq, sayohat qilmoq.
'a tour' = safar, gastrol.

items.textEn: A4  Everyone ............ (admire) the talented young man
items.whyUz:
admire → admired (2-qoida).
'to admire' = qoyil qolmoq, hayratlanmoq.
DIQQAT: 'Everyone' — grammatik jihatdan BIRLIK.

marry → married (3-qoida).
'married WITH' XATO.

continue → continued (2-qoida).
'continue WRITING' — bu yerda -ing shakli
('continue TO write' ham to'g'ri).

items.textEn: Ba  and they often ............ (invite) him to their balls.
items.whyUz:
invite → invited (2-qoida).
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
'a ball' bu yerda = raqs kechasi, bal ('to'p' EMAS).

items.textEn: Bb  and ............ (learn) to play the violin very well.
items.whyUz:
learn → LEARNT (britancha) yoki LEARNED (amerikacha).
Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI.
'learn TO play' — 'learn' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l.
'the violin' — cholg'u oldidan THE.

be → WAS (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'he' BIRLIK → was.
'when he was five' = besh yoshida.

have → HAD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'money problems' = moliyaviy qiyinchiliklar.

die → died (2-qoida).
'until' = ...gacha.

items.textEn: Bf  and ............ (play) music for kings and queens.
items.whyUz:
play → PLAYED.
'a' — UNLI tovush, keyin 'y' → Y QOLADI, faqat + ED.
'plaied' XATO.
12-mashqdagi 'enjoy → enjoyed' bilan bir xil qoida.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, match the sentences in column A to those in column B.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng A ustunidagi gaplarni B ustunidagilarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitob BIRINI chizib bergan: 1 → b.

USUL — BOG'LOVCHIGA QARANG:
  and     → qo'shimcha ma'lumot
  when    → vaqt
  because → sabab
  until   → ...gacha

Har bir B gapining boshidagi bog'lovchi
A gapiga mantiqan mos kelishi kerak.

pairs.left: 1  Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He loved music
pairs.right: b  and learnt to play the violin very well.
pairs.leftUz: Motsart 1756-yilda Avstriyaning Zalsburg shahrida tug'ilgan. U musiqani sevardi
pairs.rightUz: va skripka chalishni juda yaxshi o'rgandi.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA CHIZILGAN.
'loved music' → tabiiy davomi 'learnt to play' —
musiqani sevgani uchun cholg'u o'rgangan.

'when' — VAQT bog'lovchisi.
'started' harakati QACHON sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.
Motsart 5 yoshida bastalay boshlagan — vunderkind edi.

pairs.left: 3  He toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold
pairs.right: f  and played music for kings and queens.
pairs.leftUz: U otasi Leopold bilan G'arbiy Yevropa bo'ylab gastrol qildi
pairs.rightUz: va qirol va qirolichalar uchun musiqa chaldi.
pairs.whyUz:
'toured' (gastrol) → tabiiy davomi 'played music'.
Saroylarda chiqish qilish — gastrolning maqsadi.

pairs.left: 4  Everyone admired the talented young man
pairs.right: a  and they often invited him to their balls.
pairs.rightUz: va uni tez-tez o'z ballariga taklif qilishardi.
pairs.whyUz:
'admired' (qoyil qolish) → natijasi 'invited' (taklif).
DIQQAT: 'Everyone' birlik, lekin keyin 'THEY' —
og'zaki uslubda shunday ishlatiladi.

pairs.left: 5  In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult
pairs.right: d  because he had money problems.
pairs.leftUz: 1781-yilda u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi
pairs.rightUz: chunki uning moliyaviy muammolari bor edi.
pairs.whyUz:
'because' — SABAB bog'lovchisi.
'life was difficult' → NEGA? → 'he had money problems'.
Motsart mashhur bo'lsa ham kambag'al o'lgan —
SHUHRATNING NARXI.

pairs.left: 6  Mozart continued writing music and performing at the royal courts of Europe
pairs.right: e  until he died in 1791. He was only 35 years old.
pairs.leftUz: Motsart musiqa yozishni va Yevropa saroylarida chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi
pairs.rightUz: 1791-yilda vafot etgunicha. U atigi 35 yoshda edi.
pairs.whyUz:
'until' = ...gacha — davom etgan harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi.
'continued ... UNTIL he died' — mantiqan mos.
'the royal court' = qirol saroyi.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ TARJIMAI HOL (A va B ustunlari qo'shilgan holda):

  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in
  1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very
  well. He started writing music when he was five. He
  toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold,
  and played music for kings and queens. Everyone admired
  the talented young man and they often invited him to
  their balls. In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but
  life was difficult because he had money problems. Mozart
  continued writing music and performing at the royal
  courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35
  years old.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Volfgang Amadey Motsart 1756-yilda Avstriyaning Zalsburg
  shahrida tug'ilgan. U musiqani sevardi va skripka
  chalishni juda yaxshi o'rgandi. Besh yoshida musiqa
  yozishni boshladi. Otasi Leopold bilan G'arbiy Yevropa
  bo'ylab gastrol qildi va qirol va qirolichalar uchun
  musiqa chaldi. Hamma iqtidorli yigitga qoyil qolardi va
  uni tez-tez o'z ballariga taklif qilishardi. 1781-yilda
  u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi,
  chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi. Motsart 1791-yilda
  vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni va Yevropa saroylarida
  chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi. U atigi 35 yoshda edi.

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Motsart butun Yevropada mashhur edi, qirollar uni
  taklif qilardi — lekin PULI YO'Q edi va 35 yoshda
  vafot etdi. Diana kabi, u ham shuhrat uchun 'narx' to'ladi.

DIQQAT — 'ONLY' JOYI:
  'He was ONLY 35 years old' = atigi 35 yoshda edi.
  'only' achinish ma'nosini beradi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Salzburg      = Zalsburg (Avstriya shahri)
  a violin      = skripka
  to tour       = gastrol qilmoq
  western Europe = G'arbiy Yevropa
  to admire     = qoyil qolmoq
  talented      = iqtidorli
  a ball        = bal, raqs kechasi
  money problems = moliyaviy muammolar
  to perform    = chiqish qilmoq
  the royal court = qirol saroyi

structure.heading: 1  Tug'ilishi va musiqaga muhabbati
structure.guideUz:
A1 + Bb.
'was born IN + shahar, mamlakat, IN + yil'.
structure.modelEn: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very well.

structure.heading: 2  Bastakorlikni boshlashi
structure.guideUz:
A2 + Bc.
'when he was five' — vaqt ergash gapi.
structure.modelEn: He started writing music when he was five.

structure.heading: 3  Gastrollar
structure.guideUz:
A3 + Bf.
Ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.
structure.modelEn: He toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold, and played music for kings and queens.

structure.heading: 4  Shuhrati
structure.modelEn: Everyone admired the talented young man and they often invited him to their balls.

structure.heading: 5  Nikoh va qiyinchiliklar
structure.guideUz:
A5 + Bd.
'but ... because ...' — qarama-qarshilik va sabab.
structure.modelEn: In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.

structure.heading: 6  Oxirgi yillari
structure.guideUz:
A6 + Be.
'until' davom etgan harakatning oxirini ko'rsatadi.
structure.modelEn: Mozart continued writing music and performing at the royal courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35 years old.

wordFormation.introUz: 73-bet — -ed yozilish qoidalari, noto'g'ri fe'llar, san'at lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: UNDOSH + Y  va  UNLI + Y — eng ko'p adashtiradigan farq

patterns.formula: Ega + o'tgan zamon fe'li + ... + IN + yil.
patterns.exampleEn: He discovered penicillin in 1928 and received the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945.
patterns.exampleUz: U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va 1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.
Yil oldidan IN.

patterns.exampleEn: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
patterns.exampleUz: Leonardo da Vinchi 'Mona Liza' ni chizgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
paint → painted (to'g'ri fe'l).
Majhul shakli: 'was painted by ...'.

patterns.exampleEn: Mozart composed Requiem. Vivaldi composed The Four Seasons.
patterns.exampleUz: Motsart 'Rekviyem' ni bastalagan. Vivaldi 'To'rt fasl' ni bastalagan.

patterns.exampleEn: He started writing music. Mozart continued writing music and performing.
patterns.exampleUz: U musiqa yozishni boshladi. Motsart musiqa yozishni va chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'start' va 'continue' dan keyin -ing shakli keladi
('to' + fe'l ham to'g'ri).

patterns.formula: ... , BUT life was difficult BECAUSE he had ... .
patterns.exampleEn: In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.
patterns.exampleUz: 1781-yilda u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi, chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'but' — qarama-qarshilik;  'because' — sabab.
Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham bo'lishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: He CONTINUED ... UNTIL he DIED in [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: Mozart continued writing music until he died in 1791.
patterns.exampleUz: Motsart 1791-yilda vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni davom ettirdi.

patterns.exampleEn: They buried him in St Paul's Cathedral.
patterns.exampleUz: Uni Avliyo Pavel soborida dafn etishdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
bury → buried (undosh + Y → -IED).
'they' bu yerda aniq odamlar emas, umumiy ma'noda.
